# Key

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Input` · enum

```csharp
public enum Key
```

A layout-independent physical key identifier (scancode).

## Remarks

Values correspond to the physical position of the key on a US QWERTY keyboard, matching SDL's `SDL_Scancode` and the W3C UI Events `KeyboardEvent.code` property. Gameplay bindings should generally use `Key` so that, e.g., WASD remains in the same physical position on AZERTY or Dvorak layouts.
